motion: The camera does not move. The man stands with his hand on the back of the empty black reclining chair. He breathes out, then turns and slowly lowers himself down into the chair, sits, and lies back against it, his hands settling on the armrests, looking up. The small robot on the left stays still, its amber beacon glowing. Every other chair in the rows behind stays empty; nobody else is in the room. The camera does not move.
